query: The individuals from the ABIDE 1 and ABIDE 2 samples included in this study were diagnosed with ASD by expert clinicians based on either the Autism Diagnostic Observation Schedule (ADOS) (Lord et al., 2000; Gotham et al., 2007) or the Autism Diagnostic Interview - Revised (Lord et al., 1994).

query: All imaging data were preprocessed with the NeuroImaging Analysis Kit (NIAK) version 1.13 (Bellec et al., 2011).

query: Individuals were also excluded from the analysis if fewer than 50 time frames remained after motion censoring or if the average framewise displacement exceeded 0.3 mm.

query: During the visual QC we noticed that a large number of individuals in both the discovery and replication sample had incomplete coverage of the cerebellum.

query: For our main analysis we included all individuals and chose to remove all cerebellar networks.

query: The seed to voxel FC maps were estimated as the Pearson correlation between the average time series signal of a seed network and the time series of all gray matter voxels in the brain (excluding the cerebellum).
matched_segment: The seed to voxel FC maps were estimated as the Pearson correlation between the average time series signal of a seed network and the time series of all gray matter voxels in the brain (excluding the cerebellum).

query: Within each sample separately, the individual seed FC maps were centered to the mean of the whole sample (ASD and NTC) and known sources of variance of non-interest were regressed for each voxel at the group level: linear effects of age, head motion and imaging site.
matched_segment: Within each sample separately, the individual seed FC maps were centered to the mean of the whole sample (ASD and NTC) and known sources of variance of non-interest were regressed for each voxel at the group level: linear effects of age, head motion and imaging site.

query: We expressed the dissimilarity between pairs of individual seed FC maps as the absolute value of 1 - their spatial correlation.
matched_segment: We expressed the dissimilarity between pairs of individual seed FC maps as the absolute value of 1 - their spatial correlation.

query: For each seed network separately, we characterized communities of individuals with similar seed FC maps by hierarchical agglomerative clustering of the dissimilarity matrix for each seed network using the unweighted average distance linkage criterion (Müllner, 2011).
matched_segment: For each seed network separately, we characterized communities of individuals with similar seed FC maps by hierarchical agglomerative clustering of the dissimilarity matrix for each seed network using the unweighted average distance linkage criterion (Müllner, 2011).

query: We applied two criteria for the identification of seed FC communities: (1) the average dissimilarity between seed FC maps in a community could not be greater than 1, and (2) the community had to have at least 20 members.
matched_segment: We applied two criteria for the identification of seed FC communities: (1) the average dissimilarity between seed FC maps in a community could not be greater than 1, and (2) the community had to have at least 20 members.

query: The estimated p-values were corrected at a false discovery rate (FDR) of 5% across all FC subtypes using the Benjamini and Hochberg method (Benjamini and Hochberg, 1995).
